messages:
Maya Ortiz: Heads-up - SentinelAPI wants to evaluate Redwood as a drop-in replacement for GiantAPI. Main asks: deterministic parity for 100 regulatory prompts, KMS/HSM compatibility, and a transitional billing plan. Can we outline presales steps?
Rohan Iyer: Noted. They do ~3.2M tokens/day, peak ~4k concurrent. They want exact output for a subset of 20 prompts used in compliance, semantic parity for others. Also require function-call compatibility for structured extraction.
Grace L.: Parity risks: tokenizer differences, default stop tokens, and streaming vs non-streaming differences. We'll need their exact request payloads and any client-side post-processing rules.
Kenji S.: For function calling, we can map our schema to theirs via a compat adapter. For deterministic outputs: temperature=0 + fixed seed + tokenization shim. Can we ask them for their model name on GiantAPI?
Maya Ortiz: They use "giant-reg-v2" for compliance and have an internal top_p override. I'll request a CSV of 100 prompts (mark 20 golden) and a sample of production logs (sanitized).
sec-team: Security note: They require tenant-managed CMK in hosted mode (AWS), optional BYO-HSM in Private. Need FIPS wording and SOC2 report. Also request monthly audit bundles retained for 6 years.
finance-bot: Pricing: Sales can offer a 90-day hybrid discount that approximates their legacy flat rate; finance needs their sanitized usage to compute blended. Who will collect logs?
Rohan Iyer: I'll own log ingestion and parity runs. Proposed timeline: EOD Wed - CSV + logs; Day+1 run parity harness; Day+2 token-diff + shim prototype; Day+4 canary plan + blended quote.
Grace L.: Shim prototype snippet I'll test:
```
// compat shim example
const normalized = giantBPETokenize(prompt);
const resp = await redwood.generate({ model: 'rw-compat-regv2', input: normalized, temperature:0, seed: 7 });
return giantDetokenize(resp.tokens);
```
Maya Ortiz: I'll schedule PoC kickoff Fri 11am PT and ask them to label PII prompts. Please flag any blocker >48h.
Kenji S.: If their golden prompts fail parity we need an escalation playbook (fallback to GiantAPI for those calls) and billing credit language. Legal to draft.
Maya Ortiz: Thanks team - post parity report and any diffs here. :thumbsup:
